d: We are looking for a strategic, analytical, and business-oriented Corporate Planning Manager to lead corporate planning, business performance management, and strategic development initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional departments to develop corporate strategies, translate business objectives into actionable plans, monitor organizational performance, and support informed decision-making.
This role requires strong analytical capabilities, financial and business acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to align organizational resources and priorities with long-term business goals.
Develop, coordinate, and implement corporate strategic plans aligned with the organization's vision, mission, and long-term objectives.
Lead the annual business planning process, including corporate budgeting, forecasting, and operational planning.
Translate corporate strategies into departmental objectives, business plans, and measurable performance targets.
Work closely with senior management and department heads to establish strategic priorities and organizational goals.
Monitor corporate performance against approved business plans, budgets, KPIs, and strategic objectives.
Conduct business performance analysis and provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
Develop financial models, business forecasts, scenario analyses, and strategic planning reports.
Identify business growth opportunities, operational challenges, market trends, and potential business risks.
Coordinate the development and review of departmental business plans to ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
Establish and monitor corporate KPIs, performance dashboards, and management reporting frameworks.
Conduct variance analysis to identify gaps between planned and actual business performance.
Support management in evaluating new business initiatives, investments, expansion plans, and strategic projects.
Lead strategic business reviews and prepare presentations for executive management and board-level discussions.
Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure effective execution of corporate initiatives.
Review existing business processes and recommend improvements to enhance organizational efficiency and profitability.
Ensure timely preparation of corporate planning documents, management reports, and strategic performance updates.
Track implementation of strategic initiatives and follow up with relevant departments to ensure timely execution.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline. MBA or relevant master's degree will be preferred.
7–10 years of experience in corporate planning, strategic planning, business planning, financial planning, or business performance management.
Proven experience in developing and executing corporate business plans and strategic initiatives.
Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance analysis.
Experience in developing KPIs, management dashboards, and executive performance reports.
Strong knowledge of financial modeling, business analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Ability to analyze complex business data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and report-writing skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools will be an advantage.
Strong leadership, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to work closely with senior management and manage multiple strategic priorities.
Corporate strategic plan development and implementation.
Achievement of annual corporate business objectives.
Accuracy and effectiveness of budgeting and forecasting.
Corporate KPI tracking and performance reporting.
Business plan execution and departmental alignment.
Quality of management insights and strategic recommendations.
Timely completion of corporate planning cycles.
Effectiveness of performance monitoring and variance analysis.
Contribution to business growth, profitability, and operational efficiency.
Opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and executive management.
Exposure to strategic business decisions and corporate initiatives.
Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute directly to organizational growth and long-term business success.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

d: The Senior Façade Engineer will lead the design, coordination, technical review, and delivery of façade engineering solutions for complex building and mixed-use developments. The role is responsible for ensuring the successful integration of architectural vision, structural performance, sustainability objectives, and construction requirements into high-quality façade systems. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, overseeing façade design development, material selection, engineering analysis, procurement support, construction supervision, quality assurance, and stakeholder coordination while ensuring compliance with client requirements, international standards, and project delivery objectives.

Lead the design and engineering of building façade systems including curtain walls, cladding systems, skylights, roofing interfaces, glazing systems, architectural metalwork, and specialty façade elements.
Develop façade design concepts, specifications, calculations, and technical reports.
Perform façade performance assessments related to structural integrity, thermal performance, acoustic performance, weatherproofing, fire safety, and sustainability requirements.
Review and approve façade shop drawings, material submissions, mock-ups, and engineering calculations.
Ensure façade solutions meet architectural intent while maintaining constructability, durability, and lifecycle performance.
Coordinate closely with architects, structural engineers, MEP engineers, contractors, and specialist façade consultants.
Manage design interfaces between façade systems and surrounding building elements.
Conduct technical design reviews and identify opportunities for value engineering and optimization.
Support BIM coordination and multidisciplinary integration throughout the design process.
Review design proposals for compliance with project specifications, international standards, and local authority requirements.
Provide technical support during procurement, fabrication, installation, and commissioning phases.
Monitor façade installation activities to ensure compliance with approved designs and quality requirements.
Review testing protocols and witness performance testing including air infiltration, water penetration, structural loading, and mock-up testing.
Resolve technical issues arising during fabrication and construction.
Support project teams during inspections, handover, and defect rectification stages.
Act as the primary façade engineering representative for clients and project stakeholders.
Participate in design workshops, technical meetings, and coordination reviews.
Prepare technical reports, presentations, and engineering recommendations.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, suppliers, and specialist consultants.
Provide expert technical advice regarding façade technologies, materials, and best practices.
Support cost planning and procurement strategies for façade packages.
Identify technical and project risks associated with façade systems and implement mitigation measures.
Review contractor claims, variations, and technical change requests.
Ensure compliance with project governance procedures and contractual requirements.
Contribute to bid evaluations and contractor selection processes.
Promote sustainable façade design solutions that improve energy efficiency and environmental performance.
Ensure compliance with sustainability frameworks, energy codes, and green building certification requirements.
Maintain the highest standards of quality assurance and technical excellence.
Drive innovation through adoption of emerging façade technologies, digital engineering tools, and advanced materials.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Building Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline.
Master's Degree in Façade Engineering, Structural Engineering, Building Physics, or relevant field preferred.
12+ years of experience in façade engineering within engineering consultancy, specialist façade consultancy, contractor, or developer organizations.
Proven experience delivering complex façade packages for high-rise towers, commercial developments, hospitality projects, mixed-use developments, airports, healthcare facilities, or mega projects.
Strong experience delivering projects within the Middle East, preferably Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, or other GCC markets.
Experience managing façade design from concept through construction and handover.
Demonstrated success coordinating multidisciplinary design teams and specialist contractors.
